note: Long Dendera zodiac, decipherment variant DL2, as published in Fomenko & Nosovsky, New Chronology of Egypt, Appendix 2 (chronologia.org/nx_egypt/pril2.html; archived copy retrieved 2026-09-16). This is the variant they quote with explicit admissible ranges and a nominated 'best point' for each planet: the Sun from mid-Aries to mid-Gemini with its best point at mid-Taurus, Saturn at the Capricorn/Aquarius boundary, Jupiter at the Pisces/Aries boundary, and so on. The best points are used only to report how far the computed sky sits from the point the decoder nominated; they never influence which instants match. Order for increasing ecliptic longitude: Moon, Saturn, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, Sun, with Mercury interchangeable with the Sun.
